messages:
sam: spotted a raw SA JSON in a partner upload: gs://partner-uploads/onboard-20260321.tar.gz -> svc-ingress-prod.json. Not in Vault.
nina: yikes. partner pulled it at 2026-03-21T08:45Z. Any use seen?
sam: quick log grep shows one HEAD call from partner IP but no auth success. Treat as compromised.
raj: creating INCIDENT and starting rotation steps. Tagging @sre-oncall.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-20260321-99 

sre-oncall: Action plan: 1) make object inaccessible, 2) revoke key, 3) issue short-lived replacement, 4) scan backups.
partner-ops: we deleted our transient copy; will provide retention logs.
nina: add: export audit logs to readonly bucket before deleting any evidentiary artifacts.
raj: commands to run: `gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=svc-ingress@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com` then `gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete <OLD_KEY_ID>` after creating new key.
sre-oncall: started bucket ACL tighten: removed partners group read at 2026-03-21T08:52Z.
kms-bot: KMS team: please check if any envelope keys were using that SA for key wrapping.
partner-ops: confirming no persistence but will run retention audit and share timestamps.
sam: found two older onboarding bundles (2025-11-*) referencing svc-ingress in a test dir. Marked for quarantine.
nina: create Vault canary policy to deny reads on secret/onboard/partner/* for non-admins for 48h. Also add alert on access attempts.
raj: scanning S3/GS for JSON key patterns now. Will quarantine matches and export to gs://redwood-sec-evidence-readonly.
sre-oncall: rotation in progress, will also audit IAM bindings and remove project-level wide roles.
partner-ops: will accept new credentials via our secure ingestion endpoint; request smoke test after rotation.
sam: postmortem action: add CI gate on onboarding artifacts to reject any files matching \"private_key\"|service-account and add doc for partners about secure key exchange.
raj: incident owners: sam, nina, s re-oncall, kms-team. Closing loop when smoke test passes.
sre-oncall: incident state=mitigating, severity=high, updated 2026-03-21T09:00Z.
sam: thanks everyone. Will attach timelines and evidence. :thumbsup:
